provenance.subject: math
provenance.rule: tau: the value with the best mean validation AUC at the v1 step sizes on eedi_2020_task34, eedi_2020_task12; k_s, k_k, decay: the triple with the best mean validation AUC across assistments_2009, eedi_2020_task34, eedi_2020_task12 at that tau; then never worse than the v1 defaults by more than 0.002 AUC on the held-out students of assistments_2009, eedi_2020_task34 (a parameter that breaks this goes back to its v1 value); grade_step and transfer keep the v1 values because the public datasets have no prerequisite graph; streak_to_master and streak_expiry_days are not fitted (PRD defaults)
